title: Export (Sidiary-Format) - Type mismatch
symptom: Because of Line Feed in Remark, the exported csv isn't usable as Sidiary import file. It gives a type mismatch.
cause: Line Feed in Remark causes type mismatch in Sidiary import.
fix: Implement escaped linefeed (very special chars ||) for the export. A pull request was made to fix this.
evidence_quote: Because of Line Feed in Remark, the exported csv isn't usable as Sidiary import file. It gives a type mismatch.
